messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: hosted-api (eu-west-1) p99 > 12s over 5m. request_queue depth=11,800. Autoscaler failing to provision GPU nodes. Pager: @marta

marta: acknowledged. I'm taking oncall. Observability dashboard up? link: https://console.internal/redwood/ops/dashboards/queue-growth-eu

kai: provisioning errors look like `QuotaExceeded` for g5-family GPUs across eu-west AZs. also seeing long instance warmup times (~80-120s).

priya: customer impact: multiple tenants report 5-12% 503s and spike in p95/p99. ACME payments hitting 504 retries. Start impact triage with SRE support.

alex: quick mitigation proposals: 1) divert low-priority traffic to cpu-variant fallback 2) pause large scheduled batch workloads for 10m 3) increase eviction threshold for ephemeral inference to free GPU slots

marta: do 1 and 2 now. priya, flag high-impact tenants so we can apply allowlist routing. kai, can you paste provisioner logs?

kai: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-16T21:45:11Z provisioner: allocate_request failed err=QuotaExceeded: 'g5' family cores
pending_requests=210 warmup_est_per_instance=95s
2026-03-16T21:46:02Z provisioner: rate_limit backoff -> 30s
```

kai: also seeing autoscaler controller restart loop on leader election while trying to attach new volumes. suspect API throttling on cloud provider side.

ops-bot: Routing override applied: divert 18% of low-priority routes for hosted-api -> hosted-api.cpu-fallback (eu-west-1). Change id: r-98321.

alex: curl command used:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/v1/routing/overrides" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"scope":"eu-west-1","percent":18,"target":"hosted-api.cpu-fallback"}'
```

priya: eva_support, please reach out to top-10 impacted tenants: ACME, Beacon, RocketForms. Add mitigation note to status page.

eva_support: on it. Drafting status: "We are experiencing increased latency and intermittent errors in EU. We have diverted low-priority traffic and are provisioning additional capacity." Will post in 2m.

marta: temporary canary: enable warm-up bypass for older cold-start images (reduce initialization hooks) - doing now.

kai: made a manual scale request to provisioner to try different instance family (a2-highmem) while g5 quota is checked. Request id: prov-7742. ETA ~ 110s each.

ops-bot: prov-7742 accepted by cloud team, spinning new instances in eu-west-1b. Note: these use different GPUs; validation will take ~2 min per node.

alex: I'm pushing small config to lower batch sizes on high-latency routes to reduce per-request queueing.

priya: customer impact update: ACME error rate down to 3% after diversion, p99 down from 12.4s -> 6.1s but still above SLO. Keep tracking.

marta: timeline and next steps: 1) hold routing diversion for 20m and monitor 2) if provisioner warms nodes successfully, gradually shift traffic back 3) open quota escalation with cloud-ops to increase g5 quota 4) post incident timeline after stabilized

kai: note for postmortem: autoscaler didn't fallback to CPU-backed pool automatically because placement policy prioritized GPU family. Recommend autoscaler policy change: allow cross-family fallbacks when quota_exceeded and warmup ETA > 60s.

priya: agreement. I'll create the follow-up ticket and link to runbook: https://internal/runbooks/queue-growth-and-autoscaler (runbook steps executed: divert-traffic, pause-schedules, warmup-bypass).

marta: thumbs up. current status: partial mitigation in effect, provisioner continuing to spin nodes. Oncall handover planned in 45m unless fully resolved.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: queue depth -> 4,200. p99 -> 3.9s. autoscaler progress: +12 nodes healthy.

marta: great. leaving note: if we see re-rise or provisioner errors persist, escalate to pager duty cloud-quota team. I'll update incident channel and link final postmortem once done. :white_check_mark:
